hypothesis: The promoted standby orders-db-2 did not carry wal_level=logical from the old primary, so Debezium cannot open slot debezium_orders; set wal_level and restart the task.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames a missing wal_level=logical setting on the promoted standby, not the loss of the logical slot during failover. It also proposes setting wal_level and restarting, which ignores the missing slot and the snapshot gap. It does place the cause in the postgres layer.
